correctness.rationale: Starting from the published density, the exact log-density is reconstructed with all parameter-dependent factors. A small-\(t\) expansion proves \(\ell''(t)=-(2\beta-1)t^{-2}+o(t^{-2})\) for \(\beta\ne1/2\). The boundary \(\beta=1/2\) expansion gives the finite curvature limit \(\alpha^{-2}(\lambda^2e^\lambda/2-3/4)\). On \(\beta=1\), direct differentiation at \(t=\alpha\) gives the exact positive-curvature obstruction \(\alpha^{-2}[\lambda^2e^{-1+\lambda e^{-1/2}}-2]\).

value.rationale: Log-concavity is presented as a central shape property and is invoked by the paper to support unimodality and stability/uniqueness claims for inference. The correction shows that the stated parameter region includes locally log-convex densities and that even \(\beta=1\) can lose global log-concavity. It therefore changes the model's shape classification across a nontrivial parameter region and identifies why the published proof cannot support its inference interpretation.
